name: Phoenix
living: the steel light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe softly, moths and dust drifting through their cones
the salmon-pink sunset clouds drift slowly across the open retractable roof (sky layer drift)
downtown tower windows flicker on one by one as the sky darkens
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly on the tallest tower's spire
the first stars twinkle in the deep violet sky between the roof trusses
the right-field video board loops a slow, softly flickering sunset-skyline picture
a faint heat shimmer ripples over the red desert mountain
a lone hawk circles lazily above the saguaros now and then
crowd shimmer in both tiered stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
